subject: Re: CNC kickoff — learned normalized cuts for corpus clustering
body:
Decision checkpoint.

Umar's sampling sweep settled it: at 20% subgraph sampling the quality wobble drops to 0.1 — parity for practical purposes — and training fits comfortably on our footprint. So the bake-off verdict is: parity on quality, ~6x cheaper incremental updates, near-online cluster assignment. Retrieval wants it.

Decisions:
1) GO on handover: Quentin and Umar package the training recipe + the warmup fix; target May 22.
2) Scope cut: we do NOT take on replacing the batch re-clustering job itself this window — retrieval owns operationalizing, we deliver the model + recipe. Keeps us honest on the May 25 close.
3) Wanjiru confirmed the affinity-graph tables are migrated and validated — that dependency is closed.

Good project, and Quentin — strong first lead. Noted for calibration.

Anders
